## ✨ Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| 🛍️ **Full Cart System** | Add/remove/update quantities, persists across sessions (localStorage) |
| 💳 **Razorpay Payments** | UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets — full test & production support |
| 💵 **Cash on Delivery** | Alternative payment for customers who prefer COD |
| 📦 **Order Tracking** | Real-time status tracker (Placed → Confirmed → Preparing → Delivered) |
| 👤 **Auth System** | JWT with httpOnly cookies, register/login/logout, account lockout |
| 🔒 **Admin Dashboard** | Manage orders, products, messages, view revenue stats |
| 🌟 **Product Reviews** | Only verified purchasers can review; aggregated star ratings |
| 📧 **Contact Form** | Rate-limited, saved to DB, manageable via admin panel |
| 📱 **Responsive Design** | Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop |
| 🔄 **Webhook Backup** | Razorpay server-to-server webhook for missed payment callbacks |

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Install Dependencies

```bash
cd coffee-app
npm install
```

### 2. Configure Environment

```bash
cp .env.example .env.local
```

Edit `.env.local`:

```env
# MongoDB Atlas connection string
MONGODB_URI=mongodb+srv://user:password@cluster.mongodb.net/coffee-app

# JWT — must be at least 32 characters
JWT_SECRET=your-super-secret-jwt-key-minimum-32-chars

# Razorpay — from razorpay.com Dashboard > Settings > API Keys
RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=rzp_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx
RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET=your_razorpay_key_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_RAZORPAY_KEY_ID=rzp_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx
RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET=your_webhook_secret

# Admin user (created on first seed)
ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@coffee.com
ADMIN_PASSWORD=Admin@123456
```

### 3. Seed the Database

```bash
npm run seed
```

This creates **30 products** (across 6 categories) and an admin user.  
To re-seed products: `node scripts/seed.js --force`

### 4. Start Development Server

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) — you're brewing! ☕

## 💳 Razorpay Setup

### Get API Keys

1. Create account at [razorpay.com](https://razorpay.com)
2. Go to **Dashboard → Settings → API Keys**
3. Generate **Test Mode** keys
4. Copy `Key ID` and `Key Secret` to `.env.local`

### Payment Flow

```
POST /api/orders          ←── 1. Create order in MongoDB
POST /api/payment/create-order  ←── 2. Create Razorpay order (get rzp order ID)
[Razorpay Checkout Modal] ←── 3. User pays (UPI/Card/Net Banking)
POST /api/payment/verify  ←── 4. Verify HMAC-SHA256 signature ✅
POST /api/payment/webhook ←── 5. Server-side backup confirmation
```

### Test Credentials

| Method | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **UPI** | `success@razorpay` |
| **Visa Card** | `4111 1111 1111 1111` · Any CVV · Any future date |
| **Mastercard** | `5267 3181 8797 5449` · Any CVV · Any future date |
| **Net Banking** | Select any bank → Success |

## 🔐 Security

| Threat | Protection |
|--------|------------|
| Brute force login | 5 failed attempts → 30-min account lock |
| Token theft | `httpOnly` + `secure` + `sameSite=strict` JWT cookies |
| Fake payments | HMAC-SHA256 signature verified with `crypto.timingSafeEqual` |
| Price tampering | Server always fetches prices from DB — client prices ignored |
| Spam | Per-IP rate limiting on all sensitive routes (login, register, orders) |
| Invalid input | Zod validation on every single API route |
| XSS | httpOnly cookies block JS access to JWT |
| Clickjacking | `X-Frame-Options: DENY` header on all routes |
| Timing attacks | Simulated delay prevents email enumeration on login |
| Fake reviews | Reviews only allowed after confirmed `delivered` order |
| Admin bypass | Role check in both middleware AND individual route handlers |

## 📦 API Reference

### Auth
| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|:----:|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/auth/register` | — | Create account |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | — | Login (sets cookie) |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/logout` | — | Logout (clears cookie) |
| `GET` | `/api/auth/me` | ✅ | Get current user |

### Products
| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|:----:|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/products` | — | List (filter, search, sort, paginate) |
| `POST` | `/api/products` | 🔑 Admin | Create product |
| `GET` | `/api/products/:id` | — | Product detail |
| `PUT` | `/api/products/:id` | 🔑 Admin | Update product |
| `DELETE` | `/api/products/:id` | 🔑 Admin | Soft-delete (menu hide) |
| `POST` | `/api/products/:id/reviews` | ✅ | Add review (purchased only) |

### Orders
| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|:----:|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/orders` | ✅ | My orders (paginated) |
| `POST` | `/api/orders` | ✅ | Place order |
| `GET` | `/api/orders/:id` | ✅ | Order detail |
| `PATCH` | `/api/orders/:id` | ✅ | Cancel order / Admin update status |

### Payments
| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|:----:|-------------|
| `POST` | `/api/payment/create-order` | ✅ | Create Razorpay order |
| `POST` | `/api/payment/verify` | ✅ | Verify payment signature |
| `POST` | `/api/payment/webhook` | — | Razorpay server webhook |

### Admin
| Method | Endpoint | Auth | Description |
|--------|----------|:----:|-------------|
| `GET` | `/api/admin/stats` | 🔑 Admin | Revenue, orders, users summary |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/orders` | 🔑 Admin | All orders with filters |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/products` | 🔑 Admin | All products (incl. hidden) |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/messages` | 🔑 Admin | Contact form messages |
| `PATCH` | `/api/admin/messages/:id` | 🔑 Admin | Mark as read/replied |

## 🚢 Deployment (Vercel)

```bash
# Verify build locally first
npm run build

# Then deploy
git push origin main   # triggers Vercel auto-deploy
```

> **Production checklist:**
> - Switch Razorpay to **Live Mode** keys
> - Add webhook URL: `https://your-domain.vercel.app/api/payment/webhook`
> - Set `NODE_ENV=production` in Vercel environment variables
> - Use MongoDB Atlas (not local) for production database

---

## 🐛 Edge Cases Handled

- ✅ Cart persists across browser refreshes via `localStorage`
- ✅ Razorpay SDK loaded dynamically — no Next.js SSR conflicts
- ✅ Payment modal dismissed → order saved, user can retry payment
- ✅ Duplicate Razorpay payment requests are idempotent (returns existing)
- ✅ Client-sent prices are **never trusted** — always re-fetched from DB
- ✅ Products are soft-deleted so historical order data stays intact
- ✅ Order cancellation blocked once order is in `preparing` or later
- ✅ Reviews blocked unless order is in `delivered` status
- ✅ MongoDB connection pooled safely for Next.js hot-reload in dev
- ✅ Free delivery threshold (₹500+) enforced server-side, not client
- ✅ GST (5%) calculated and stored immutably on order creation
- ✅ Full status history with timestamps stored per order
